canonical_json: UTF-8; json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False). No BOM. JSON artifact files end with one LF. Fingerprint serialization has no LF. No insignificant whitespace in required JSON artifacts.
cli: Success 0. Any invalid query, policy mismatch, corrupt bundle, unsafe output, invalid source structure, or changed --resume returns 2. Failed search preserves pre-existing ANSWERS bytes. Same source inventory+effective policy resume returns 0 and leaves all four artifact bytes and mtimes unchanged. Failed build preserves existing output artifacts; fresh build may create OUT only when no protected collision exists. Build without --resume refuses a nonempty OUT. verify succeeds without source data; checks format/hashes/schema/read-only logical consistency, not source truth. search/verify/serve may not change any bundle file byte or mtime.
cli_commands: python kb.py build --input DATA --out OUT [--policy FILE] [--resume]
python kb.py search --index OUT --queries FILE --out ANSWERS [--policy FILE]
python kb.py serve --index OUT --host 127.0.0.1 --port PORT [--policy FILE]

csv.tag_weights: UTF-8 without BOM, exact header tag,weight. tag nonempty exact string; weight ASCII [1-9][0-9]*. Duplicate tag invalid. CSV extra/missing columns or malformed encoding invalid. Empty files and blank physical CSV rows invalid. CSV record order carries no meaning.
csv.tenants: CP949 bytes, CSV newline rules, exact header tenant_id,label. tenant_id nonempty exact string; label any string including empty. Duplicate tenant_id and reserved __public__ row invalid. Registered nonpublic tenants only.

document_schema: Exact 10 fields record_id,tenant_id,doc_id,revision,updated_at,published_at,state,title,body,tags; no additional or missing keys. Identifier fields nonempty strings; revision nonboolean integer >=0; state PUBLISHED or WITHDRAWN; title nonblank string; body any string; tags array of known exact strings, with repetitions allowed.
http: GET /health => 200 {status:ok,policy_id:<id>}; GET /stats => stats; POST /search one query => result. Malformed JSON/query =>400 {error:BAD_QUERY}. Unknown path404 {error:NOT_FOUND}; unsupported method405 {error:METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED}. GET / => UTF-8 HTML for nondevelopers, includes policy id, max results, as_of, document count, and limitation that this is evidence retrieval with no generated counseling answer. JSON responses canonical+LF; HTML contents not exact-byte graded. Policy mismatch fails before listen with exit2.
id_rules: record_id, tenant_id, doc_id and tag identifiers are nonempty exact strings. Never strip, casefold, normalize Unicode, or coerce numeric-looking identifiers. qid is a nonempty string. title must contain at least one nonwhitespace code point; body may be empty.
json_types: Boolean never satisfies integer. Non-finite JSON numbers and duplicate object keys are invalid at every depth.
line_processing: Files sorted by relative UTF-8 path bytes; lines in physical order. Strip one terminal LF and preceding CR, and optional UTF-8 BOM only at first physical line of each file. A payload is blank iff empty or valid UTF-8 consisting entirely of Unicode whitespace. Nonblank payload >65536 bytes => OVERSIZE before UTF-8 or JSON validation. Otherwise invalid UTF-8/JSON/duplicate keys/nonfinite => BAD_JSON; bad fields or unknown tenant/tag => BAD_SCHEMA; either updated_at or published_at after as_of => FUTURE; previously retained record_id => DUPLICATE_RECORD_ID; else retain.

manifest.inventory_rule: Every DATA regular file recursively, including original policy and META, sorted by relative path UTF-8 bytes. Reject symlinks and nonregular entries. OUT must be disjoint from DATA and may not alias any source.

policy.overlay: --policy supplies a complete replacement policy object; DATA/policy.json stays unchanged. policy_fingerprint = SHA256(canonical effective policy). effective_at must not exceed META.as_of_utc.

queries: Exact keys qid,tenant_id,terms, optional limit. qid and tenant_id nonempty strings; terms array of strings (empty and unknown terms permitted); limit positive nonboolean integer. Distinct terms once. Tenant must be registered nonpublic tenant; __public__ query is FORBIDDEN. Unknown tenant FORBIDDEN before matching. Known tenant sees own plus __public__. Sum positive integer weights of matching distinct exact terms. score>0 only; order (-score, doc_id UTF-8 bytes, tenant_id UTF-8 bytes); cap min(limit or policy.max_results, policy.max_results).

exact_fields.retained_records: eligible unique record_id records before version selection

invariants: sum(counts.values()) + retained_records = actual nonblank document lines
UNKNOWN tenant or tag is BAD_SCHEMA
record_id becomes reserved only when first eligible valid record is retained

result.serialization: canonical JSON plus LF per query, including HTTP response bodies as canonical JSON plus LF

selection: Within exact (tenant_id,doc_id), greatest revision then actual updated_at instant; exact tie retains first physical record. Latest WITHDRAWN hides key. published_at is used only for future exclusion. record_id dedup spans all files and tenants.

sqlite.determinism: Fresh SQLite bytes may differ; required logical rows and all search answers must be deterministic.
sqlite.docs: Only selected PUBLISHED records. tags stores canonical JSON array preserving input tag order and duplicates. Extra columns/tables/indexes permitted; required table names and column types remain usable. No private-only schema.

required_meta.registered_tenants: canonical JSON array of every registered nonpublic tenant_id sorted by UTF-8 bytes
required_meta.tag_weights: canonical JSON object mapping every known tag to positive nonboolean integer weight

required_tables.docs: tenant_id TEXT, doc_id TEXT, revision INTEGER, title TEXT, body TEXT, tags TEXT; PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,doc_id)
required_tables.meta: key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT

invariants: all counts are nonnegative nonboolean integers

timestamps: Aware ISO-8601 string accepted by datetime.fromisoformat after terminal Z -> +00:00; no surrounding whitespace; reject a missing offset, non-string, bool, invalid date, or a date-only value. Compare actual instants. Original strings need not be canonicalized.
verify_limits: Validate canonical JSON artifact shapes/types, hashes, internal fingerprints, required DB table/column shape, unique key/content types, registered_tenants/tag_weights meta shapes/canonical values, docs tenant membership and known tags, doc_count=COUNT(docs), selected_keys=doc_count+withdrawn_count, required DB meta and policy agreement. No fresh rebuild/source provenance claim. Verify does not require source files.
